hooks.name: ptuf-bootstrap
hooks.description: When a session starts, install the pinned ptuf binary into .cache/bin (checksum-verified) so the ptuf PreToolUse guard below can run. Fresh cloud clones do not have it.

hooks.name: ptuf
hooks.description: Before every tool call, ask ptuf (policy in .ptuf.yaml) whether to allow, ask or deny it. If the binary is missing, block the call instead of running unguarded.

action.command: if [ -x .cache/bin/ptuf ]; then exec .cache/bin/ptuf hook kiro-v3; fi; echo 'ptuf is not installed, so tool calls are blocked. Run: bash scripts/bootstrap-ptuf.sh' >&2; exit 2
